text: {"lessons":["Selling some shares after gains has felt satisfying, but I should not let that feeling alone dictate when or how much I sell.","Buying more across all five stocks in Period 4 did not prevent my account value from falling; I should keep diversification and overall risk in mind.","Prices have moved both up and down, and past changes do not predict what comes next, so I should make each decision without assuming a trend will continue."]}
